QUOTE: "Add the code to the right header, e.g. `include/mbedtls/aes.h`. Pick an unused value in the module's range and write a Doxygen comment, either `/**< ... */` after the define or `/** ... */` before it. The text becomes the message." and "Regenerate: `cd library && make` ... Don't edit `error.c` by hand."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add a documented #define to the public header, regenerate, and not hand-edit error.c.
